note: Mandy (Dave 2026-10-21): anything placed in the world (fire, bench, chest, shelter, forge...) clears grass, leaf litter and small plants in a circle around it, at once, and they stay away while it stands. One number: the radius in metres. The outer 1.5 m thins out instead of ending in a sharp line. Felled trunks (Dave 2026-10-21) do not clear: the grass under a lying trunk and trunk_margin_m (0.3 m) out on each side is pressed flat, kept to trunk_squash (0.15) of its height, while the trunk lies there.
